text:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME (HW partner) asked for a private marketplace offer. They want ~25% discount at a $500k commit but need a 90-day conversion window from metered -> committed. Also asking for a renewal accelerator: +5% off if renew usage >= 80%. Can we align?

Ryan: 90 days is long. standard is 30–60. @Liz, flagged for finance.

Liz: 90d = risk. We can consider 90 if we add a ramp milestone + escrow (25% credits held as guarantee). need rev rec / legal signoff.

Devon: Product flag — marketplace model variants must be equivalent during the commit period. If we do model upgrades/canaries we should include a 'model equivalence' clause to avoid quality regressions.

Maya: ACME also wants a private SKU that bundles dedicated capacity + HW credits for their SI. They asked for BYOH credits to offset dedicated fees.

Ryan: BYOH credits ok but cap at 30% of committed value. also add a usage floor so credits can't drive $0 net.

Liz: Draft discount tiers proposal:
```
tier1: $250k -> 15%
tier2: $500k -> 25%
tier3: $1M   -> 32% + 5% renewal accelerator if usage >= 80%
```
We should add a clawback: at renewal, if converted usage <60% then clawback 1.5x of the unused credit value applied as credit reduction.

Devon: Rollout suggestion — start with a 60-day pilot private offer (canary). if pilot meets usage SLA we flip to full commit. Include auto-fallback to hosted-compatible model variants / rates in case of capacity constraints.

Maya: ACME legal also wants a joint announcement / co-branding window. they'd like a press release + launch. legal ok with 30-day embargo. @Liz do discounts trigger partner co-sell credits?

Liz: Yes — apply co-sell credit = 10% of discount uplift, recorded as partner MSP credit. cap total partner credit to 10% of ARR to avoid over-indexing.

Ryan: Action items: 
- Liz: finalize discount tiers + clawback language by Tue
- Devon: draft model-equivalence clause + fallback policy
- Maya: push back on 90d ask and negotiate 60d pilot vs 90d conversion window
- @ops-bot: create ticket for private SKU setup (MP-4521)

ops-bot: Created MP-4521 — "Private SKU: ACME dedicated bundle + BYOH credits"; owner @platform-eng.

Maya: Thanks. last note — ACME legal requested a "renewal-trigger matrix" doc showing scenarios (usage bands, accelerator triggers, clawbacks). I’ll draft and share tomorrow for review. :+1:
